## Construction and application to the parent

All new declarations belong to YulangClosure.OccurrenceQualifiedFactReadersR65.
Inventory.edges is the complete provenance list. candidates filters solely by
occurrence/slot, preserving order, duplicate multiplicity, dangling references
and foreign owners until after singleton selection. every_edge_at_key gives
exact membership. resolve requires a semantic FactId owned by this store, its
actual indexed table row and exact row identity. readAt_iff, resolve_iff and
readAt_coordinate expose these conditions. readSelectedAt also compares the
entire selected fact: identity, term endpoints and raw/canonical endpoint pairs.
Dangling rows, same-key ambiguity (even two equal edges), foreign stores,
wrong indexed identities and endpoint mismatches reject. The foreign-key
extension theorem quantifies over every appended edge at another key while
retaining the fact table. Generic and concrete shared-FactId theorems succeed.

internalInputs updates the existing R45 input type over an R55 source inventory:
the exact use coordinate is captured before checking FactId, and Lambda facts
come from slot2. All other source/construction/permission/recipe/component/
TermView readers remain projections of the same source input. route_read_iff,
lambda_read_iff and route_input_agreement expose exact source/fact/endpoints.
qualified_internal_extract applies the existing R45 checker.
qualified_internal_source_facts applies its accepted constructor/endpoints
result back to actual qualified slot0/slot2 reads of that same certificate.

current updates the existing R47 type over R57: semantic source keys and root
candidate/task reads use the same qualified inventory. Store mismatch rejects.
Root candidates retain every matching source/state/endpoint Origin. Root tasks
reconcile the drain's cause/slot and canonical endpoints. The collected Catch
slot51 reader is retained verbatim by collected_source_reader_retained.
No R48 arrival bundle or whole R49 Context is claimed constructed.

rootQuery derives use, fact and raw entry from one Internal certificate.
qualified_root_extract applies CurrentEmissionOwnershipR47.apply_to_internal
with reflexive same-use/fact/raw-entry equations. The conclusion keeps the
identical full permission/concrete list, current physical bound, raw entry owner
and root-to-entry RelationPath. R45 acceptance and R47 Matches remain explicit
premises; the finite theorem discharges both for an actual mathematical instance.

shared_fact_distinct_occurrences_succeed checks semantic FactId (store2,index0)
at occurrence100/slot0 and occurrence101/slot0, including selected-fact reads.
finite_qualified_internal_and_root checks R45 and R47 extraction for that same
use/fact/raw permission entry and preserves [7,7,11], including multiplicity.
The finite negative theorem checks ambiguity, dangling references, foreign
owners and endpoint disagreement. These are mathematical finite witnesses,
not native runtime observations, supported-source counterexamples or Run receipts.

Represented: generic branded source keys and all R57 Value/Effect endpoint
constructors, semantic FactIds, term/raw/canonical endpoints, every provenance
edge, R55 source/Internal inventories and R47 physical lanes. Collected slot51
reads remain projections of their existing reader. Omitted/unproved: native
allocation tokens/pointer identity, numeric edgeIndex round trips, authentic
source/table/TermView extraction, actual successful outer Runs and original
source judgment correspondence. edgeIndex is retained metadata; the proof
establishes membership in the complete edge list, not native pointer identity
at that numeric index. Equality of FactRows does not authenticate Rust pointers.
